title: Lighthouse error layers illustration pack for onboarding quickstart
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Create a cohesive set of illustrative assets and annotated screenshots to surface within the Quickstart/onboarding flow that communicate transient and persistent inference errors. Focus areas: rate caps (soft vs hard limits), request timeouts and retry behaviour, and guidance for developer recovery steps. Deliverables include 6 art tiles (hero + 3 states + compact variants), 4 annotated product screenshots showing in-console placement, and a small copy pack with microcopy variants for CTA and troubleshooting tips. Aim for asset reusability across the quickstart modal, docs inline callouts, and the 'first-run diagnostic' card in Console.
acceptance_criteria: Six SVG/PNG art tiles exported at 1x/2x with tokenized layers in Figma
Four annotated console screenshots with numbered callouts and matching microcopy
Accessible color contrast (AA) for all text overlays and iconography
Responsive compact variants for mobile and narrow panes
Designer handoff file with export tokens and recommended usage notes
design_notes: Prioritize clarity over metaphor: illustrations should map directly to action (e.g., 'Increase quota', 'Retry with backoff', 'Contact admin'). Avoid ambiguous metaphors like storms or broken bridges. Use the existing Redwood brand palette with a new accent for 'retry' actions (teal-60). For rate-limit visuals, show a soft-cap gradient vs hard-cap lock icon. For timeout, show progressive spinner -> truncated response state. Compact tiles must be legible down to 160px width. Consider an animated Lottie variant for the hero tile later (separate ticket).
decisions: Use the rounded card frame system from the quickstart component library
Iconography should rely on the system glyph set; create 3 new glyphs (soft-cap, hard-lock, backoff-arrow)
Microcopy default tone: action-first, 6-word CTA max
